responses: Hello! Welcome to customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi there! What can I assist you with?
Welcome! Please tell me how I can help.
Thank you for contacting us! Have a great day.
Goodbye! We're happy to help whenever you need us.
Take care, and thank you for choosing us.
You're welcome! Is there anything else I can help you with?
Happy to help!
You're welcome. Thank you for contacting us.
We're here to help you with products, orders, payments, deliveries, and customer support. Please tell me what you'd like to know.

patterns: What features does this product have?
I want to know more about a product
responses: I'd be happy to help with product information. Please share the product name or ID.

patterns: How much do I need to pay?
Can I get a cheaper price?
responses: Please share the product name or ID so I can help you find its price and available offers.

patterns: How do I place an order?
How can I order a product?
Can you help me place an order?
responses: You can select your product, add it to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Let me know if you face any difficulty.

patterns: I didn't receive an order confirmation
I have not received my order number
responses: Please check your email and spam folder for the confirmation. If you still cannot find it, contact support with your registered details.

patterns: I want to know where my package is
Is my package on the way?
responses: I can help you with order tracking. Please provide your order ID so the order status can be checked.

patterns: The expected delivery date has passed
responses: I'm sorry your order hasn't arrived yet. Please share your order ID so the delivery status can be checked.

patterns: When will my order be delivered?
What is the estimated delivery time?
How many days will shipping take?
responses: Delivery time depends on your location and the product. Please share your order details or delivery area for more information.

patterns: Why was I charged for delivery?
responses: Shipping charges depend on the order and delivery location. Please check the checkout page or share your order details for assistance.

patterns: Can I update my shipping address?
I want my order delivered somewhere else
How do I correct my address?
responses: I can guide you through updating your address. Please check whether your order has already shipped, as address changes may not be possible afterward.

patterns: I want to cancel my order
How can I cancel an order?
Can I cancel an order after placing it?
responses: I can help you with the cancellation process. Please provide your order ID and check whether cancellation is still available.

patterns: How do I return an item?
I want to send my purchase back
How many days do I have to return a product?
responses: Return eligibility and deadlines depend on the product and store policy. Please share the product or order details so you can check the applicable rules.

patterns: How do I get my money back?
When will I receive my refund?
How long does a refund take?
I returned my product but haven't received my money
responses: I'm happy to guide you through the refund process. Please share your order ID and refund status, without sharing sensitive payment details.

patterns: How do I exchange an item?
Can I replace this with another product?
responses: Exchange options depend on product availability and store policy. Please share your order ID and the item you'd like to exchange.
I'm sorry your product arrived damaged. Please share your order ID and, if possible, a photo of the damage through the official support channel.

patterns: This is not what I ordered
My package contains the wrong item
You sent me a different product
The color is different from what I ordered
responses: I'm sorry you received the wrong item. Please share your order ID and the product you received so the issue can be investigated.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?
Can I use a debit card?
Can I pay through net banking?
responses: Available payment methods depend on the store and checkout options. Please check the payment section during checkout.

patterns: The payment page shows an error
responses: I'm sorry your payment failed. Please check your payment app or bank status before trying again to avoid duplicate payments.

patterns: There are two charges for one order
I paid two times by mistake
Why is there a duplicate transaction?
I see two payments for the same purchase
responses: I'm sorry about the duplicate charge. Please check your transaction history and contact official support with the transaction references. Never share your PIN or OTP.

patterns: Where can I download my bill?
Can you send me a receipt?
How do I get a GST invoice?
responses: You may be able to download your invoice from your order history or confirmation email. If it isn't available, contact support with your order ID.

patterns: How do I create an account?
Help me create a new account
How do I join your website?
Can I shop without an account?
responses: You can usually register through the Sign Up option on the website or app. Follow the instructions to complete your registration.

patterns: My account login is not working
The website won't let me sign in
I keep getting a login error
Why am I unable to log in?
responses: Please check your email or username and password, and try again. If the issue continues, use the official account recovery option.

patterns: How can I reset my password?
I cannot remember my login password
I need to change my password
The password reset link is not working
responses: Use the Forgot Password option on the login page and follow the recovery instructions. Never share your password or verification code with anyone.

patterns: How do I change my profile details?
I want to change my email address
How can I edit my account information?
Can I update my personal details?
responses: You can usually update your information in your account settings. Some changes may require identity verification.

patterns: I think my account was hacked
My account is being used by someone else
I received a suspicious login alert
I see an order I did not place
How do I secure my account?
responses: I'm sorry this happened. Change your password using the official website, secure your email, and contact support immediately about unauthorized activity.
I'm sorry you're experiencing a technical issue. Try refreshing the page or updating the app. If the problem continues, tell us what error you see.

patterns: How do I apply a coupon?
My discount code is not working
Where do I enter my coupon?
Do you have any discount codes?
responses: Enter your coupon code in the discount field at checkout. Check the expiry date, minimum order value, and eligibility conditions.

patterns: Does this product have a warranty?
My product is still under warranty
How do I claim a warranty?
Where can I find warranty details?
Is the warranty included in the price?
responses: Warranty coverage depends on the product and manufacturer. Please share the product name or model to find the applicable warranty information.

patterns: I want to talk to a human
Can I speak to an agent?
I don't want to talk to a bot
responses: Of course. If live support is available, you can request a human agent through the official support channel. I can also help collect the details of your issue.

patterns: I want to make a complaint
I had a bad customer experience
I want to report a problem
I'm not satisfied with the support
responses: I'm sorry we haven't met your expectations. Please explain what happened so we can identify the best next step.

patterns: Where can I leave a review?
How can I rate your service?
I want to share my experience
responses: Thank you for sharing your feedback! We'd love to hear about your experience and suggestions.

patterns: Can I contact support at night?
When can I call your team?
responses: Support hours vary by company. Please check the official Contact Us page for current working hours.

patterns: What is your customer care number?
Do you have an email address?
How do I reach customer support?
Can I contact you by email?
responses: Please visit the official Contact Us page for verified customer support phone numbers, email addresses, and other contact options.

patterns: How do you use my data?
How can I delete my personal data?
Can I request my data to be deleted?
responses: Please review the company's official privacy policy for details about data collection, use, retention, and deletion requests.

patterns: Can you help me with homework?
Tell me something unrelated to shopping
responses: I'm designed to help with customer service questions. I can assist with orders, products, payments, returns, and account issues.
